content:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock down owners and thresholds for third-party auth + model-registry flakiness. Putting proposed actions here for signoff.

mike: thanks, sara. can we call out which alerts were noisy vs signal? i saw a ton of 5xx spikes from model-registry-proxy.

anita: noisy = 502s from registry when authlatency > 300ms. signal = sustained 5xx > 5m. we should tighten the alerting window.

kim: suggestion: add a `registry_5xx::5m` alert and a separate `auth_latency::1m` with paging on severity. keeps ops pager smaller.

chris: agreed. also we should add a circuit-breaker layer in front of model-registry with short TTL cache for key metadata so we reduce chattiness during auth provider slowdowns.

ops_lead: list of concrete action items (proposed):
- Owner: @mike -> tighten alerts + alert doc update (ETA 72h)
- Owner: @anita -> implement registry-side short TTL cache + circuit-breaker (ETA 2w)
- Owner: @kim -> runbook clarifications and oncall playbook (ETA 5d)
- Owner: @chris -> vendor contact escalation + push for SLA clarification (SUP-4321 opened) (ETA 48h)

mike: taking alerts. i'll open PR to adjust thresholds and add examples.

anita: taking cache/circuit-breaker. prototype will be a simple redis-backed prefix cache with key expiry 10s, expandable. will post benchmarks.

chris: SUP-4321 created with vendor. i added logs and sample traces. vendor assigned P2 for now. i'll share updates in this thread.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: `infra/alerts#389` -> staging. status: started.

oncall-bot: oncall paging config updated? need approvers for pager rules change.

kim: i'll own runbook text and clarity around thresholds and escalation matrix. will also add a short decision tree for when to fail open vs degrade.

ops_lead: we also have a recurring pattern note: similar auth spikes observed ~monthly for last 3 months (see links). request: set a monthly vendor sync + a quarterly dry-run for fallback flows. who can co-own vendor sync?

chris: i'll lead vendor syncs; kim + anita to attend. propose first sync next Tue 10am.

mike: timeline ok for alerts. i'll include playbook link in PR.

anita: will schedule a small dry-run in staging to exercise cache + fallback this Friday. cc @deploy-bot for deployment window.

ops_lead: accountability check: owners above confirm ETAs and add to the postmortem action tracker. i'll follow up in 48h for status.

kim: confirmed. i'll update runbook and add a tiny flowchart. :white_check_mark:

chris: vendor update: SUP-4321 -> vendor responded, they're investigating token-store GC as likely culprit. asked for detailed timeline by EOD.

mike: PR opened: `infra/alerts#390` with test cases. tagging @ops_lead for review.

anita: prototype done in staging, cache cut error rate in half for short bursts. will make infra PR tomorrow.

ops_lead: good progress. next steps:
- everyone, add your action item to the tracker doc (link pasted in postmortem) with owner/ETA/status
- kim to add runbook clarifications (ETA 5d)
- chris to confirm vendor SLA changes or mitigation commitments (ETA 3d)

sara: thanks all. i'll consolidate into the postmortem doc and ping engineering leadership once all ETAs land. please keep incremental updates in this thread so the incident retro board can pick them up.

chris: vendor EOD update: they acknowledged token-store GC bug and scheduled a patch window next week. will update SUP-4321.

oncall-bot: incident follow-up reminder set for 48h.

mike: pinging here when alerts PR is merged.

anita: marking cache PR draft, linking perf numbers.

ops_lead: closing action assignment round for now. if anything slips, flag asap. thanks team.
